what: SPEC1 Part I item 4; fields in the docstring of jobs/describe_neurons.py
note: offset 0 is the position that reads the first token of the first loop cycle (the position at offset -1 wrote it); the repeated text starts at offset = period. z = (mean a - normal_mean) / normal_sd per neuron, normal text = the stored answers. 'normal' aligns the same window on the middle of each stored answer, with the median period (the matched control). 'period' and period_trace: the same in units of the row's own period, bin b holding the tokens at offsets [b, b + 1) * period / 40; period_offsets gives each bin's centre in periods.
